## Checklist

- [ ] Light mode + dark mode verified
- [ ] Responsive from 320 px up
- [ ] Keyboard navigable
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for text
- [ ] Lighthouse ≥ 95 (perf, a11y, best-practices, SEO) — local or preview audit
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] E2E tests added/updated where the path is critical
- [ ] Per-project `README.md` updated
- [ ] `PROGRESS.md` updated
- [ ] No `.env` or secrets committed
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` clean locally
